title: Python: SRH encode/decode
notes: Implemented RFC 6554 full-address SRH decode validation in Python: explicitly parses and rejects unsupported nonzero CmprI/CmprE, rejects nonzero Pad for the uncompressed profile, ignores Reserved bits as RFC-required while canonicalizing them to zero on encode, and rejects non-Routing extension wrappers. Added deterministic regressions for truncated fixed fields, compressed address modes, pad values, reserved-bit acceptance, misaligned address vectors, empty/zero-segment round trips, wrong wrapper types, and exact RFC 8200 Hdr Ext Len serialization. Verification green: full python/tests/rpl 650 passed (one unrelated pytest deprecation warning); relay SRH/source-route subset 8 passed, 35 deselected; Ruff passed; mypy passed; git diff --check passed. No forwarding/C/Zephyr scope added.
